summary: Implemented the commit-failure status demotion across four phases: a gated block in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's WORK (i) demotes state.json to partial, amends the handoff, and flips verdict to defer on a genuinely non-landing per-cycle commit (exit 2/3/4/5) for a just-completed implement dispatch, with exit 6/7 and non-implement outcomes provably untouched. Added both-polarity regression test coverage, documented the sanctioned terminal-state exception in two files, and deployed with the scoped-gate narrowing (5 suites) green. The full gate-8 battery is deferred to this batch's once-per-invocation stage per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive and is attributed back via modified_files.
